items.Name: Nimble Sash
items.Description: Belts of this kind came about to aid the scouts of the Arass Saa lizardfolk in spotting and evading the many poisonous snakes in their swamp.  The design proved successful, and the belts were traded to the friendly druids of the area, who aided the lizardfolk in halting the expa…

items.Name: Belt of Priestly Might
items.Description:
These items first appeared in Halruaa at the end of the Time of Troubles, which the wizards took as a sign that Mystra had returned.

Only the truly faithful are able to wear this belt. Those not in the direct service of the Gods find themselves unable to buckle the belt.

items.Name: Belt of Priestly Might and Warding
items.Description:
These items first appeared in Halruaa at the end of the Time of Troubles, which the wizards took as a sign that Mystra had returned.

Only the truly faithful are able to wear this belt. Those not in the direct service of the Gods find themselves unable to buckle the belt.
PropertiesDecoded: Magic Circle against Alignment (5) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Greater Belt of the Rogue Stalker
items.Description: The real deal berk. This here belt was designed by a bounty hunter who specialized in sneak-thieves. Theres no better trinket on any black market anywhere in the planes that'll do as much to help you avoid being stabbed in the back, while also keeping your pants up.

items.Name: Belt of the Rogue Stalker
items.Description: Enchanted to get the wearer out of harms way no matter the cost.

items.Name: Belt of Great Sacrifice
items.Description:
Some adventurers would disdain the use of this belt due to it's harsh drawbacks. But a few are bold enough to sacrifice their other faculties if it means they may be able to land that devastating blow to end a key battle. 

After all, without great sacrifices, we would have noth…

items.Name: Scout's Belt
items.Description: Designed by celestial enchanters who were charged with devising proper trinkets for use by upper planar armies, these belts were first used by their scouts.

items.Name: Sash of Shimmering
items.Description: When the wizard Midnight of the prime material world of Toril saw her abilities grow so great as to assume a station amongst the gods, her soul drank magic straight from the fabric of the weave. She ascended, abandoning much of her mortal self and belongings, though they too wer…

items.Name: Belt of Spell Storing
items.Description:
This belt pulses with magic, and spells are scribed into the belt itself, available, with but a single command word.  It has its own mana pool, making it a perfect item for one who is in need, yet cannot sacrifice their own energies.

It has a definitive feeling of goodness abou…
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Serious Wounds (10) Cast Spell 3 Charges/Use

items.Name: Sunite Sash
items.Description: This scarlet sash is woven of fine red thread and delicate gold wire. Crafted by the Priests of Sune, it is magically enchanted to make the wearer more beautiful and charming to those around them.

items.Name: Black Leather Belt
items.Description: This black leather belt bears the insignia of the assassin's guild, The Dying Light.

items.Name: Tools of the Trade
items.Description: A boon to those who do second-story work, this belt has a number of small pouches in which are concealed the tools of the trade.

items.Name: Ceremonial Uthgardt Belt
items.Description: In an attempt to keep the thriving Uthgardt clans under control, a long-forgotten gathering of druids inflicted them with a virulent pox. This disease soon spread out of control, and far from curbing their numbers actually threatened their extinction. To maintain the balance, th…

items.Name: Belt of the Weave
items.Description: This belt has a visible glow of magic about it, and indeed, it feels connected to the weave itself,  and almost insures that any spell the caster attempts, will not be lost.

items.Name: Belt of Wonder
items.Description: Nobody knows how belts of these kind came about, but some sutle hints point to Celestial origins. Those who have dedicated themselves to a path of evil, or even of neutrality, cannot bear to put these belts on.

items.Name: Boots of Balance
items.Description: The wearer of these soft, low-heeled supple leather boots is endowed with a magically enhanced sense of balance.

items.Name: Boots of Amazing Footwork
items.Description:
This type of footwear was originally owned by a Pirate from the Moonshae Isles named Buck McMasters. Buck enjoyed a famous reign on the high seas with his partner and best friend, a Sembian named Nigel Witherspoon.

These boots were the first magical trinket that Buck ever bough…

items.Name: Deceptor's Boots
items.Description: These plain leather boots don't appear to be anything special on first glance. Closer inspection reveals that they are magically enchanted to allowe the wearer to deceive the eyes of those around him. They are highly prized by certain groups around the multiverse.

items.Name: Boots of Dodging
items.Description: Normith, a Sigilian tief sorcerer, was known to often escape danger with exceptionally quick reflexes. The source of his abilities was discovered after Normith died from a rival spellcaster's phantasmal killer. This rival then, upon finding the magical boots, went and made copie…

items.Name: Dragon Slippers
items.Description: Feryl Dragonhunter was a monster of a man who, with four kills to his credit, thought he had perfected the art of dragon slaying. He aided his efforts by creating magical equipment from his previous victories, including several different boots he mockingly called his Dragon Slip…

items.Name: Boots of Hardiness (Dweomered)
items.Description: Having explored the Outer Planes extensively, a druid named Aawill commissioned the creation of these comfortable boots. Knowing he was heading for the sometimes-dangerous domain of the Karasuthra, Aawill was looking for something helpful in combat, to lighten his need for armor…

items.Name: Boots of Reflexes (Dweomered)
items.Description: In the dark night of Sigil, the rich and powerful protect themselves from the predations of the thieves by constructing elaborate traps throughout their homes. To counter this, the thieves created these boots to quicken the reactions of their top assassins and burglars.

items.Name: Boots of Striding (Dweomered)
items.Description: Blessed by priests of Shaundakul the Windrider, these boots seem to make even the most arduous journey easier and more pleasant. This is accomplished not by increasing the wearer's speed, but by making him hardier and more resistant to pain. Numerous versions of these boots exis…

items.Name: Monk Boots (Dweomered)
items.Description: The powers alone know which order or sect first began using this now common enchantment on their footwear. It is thought they may have been invented somewhere in Limbo by either the Buomanns or Githzerai, who's peoples have the earliest recorded history of what can be classified…

items.Name: Elven Boots
items.Description: While not the famed Boots of Elvenkind, these less well made copies have one distinct advantage over their more powerful cousins.

items.Name: Boots of Elvenkind
items.Description: Several pairs of this type of boot were made for elven battalions during the Year of Singing Arrows, 884 DR('Dale Reckoning', after a region on the continent of Faerun in Toril called 'The Dlaes'). The scouts equipped with this stealthy footwear turned the tide of at least two m…

items.Name: Gargoyle Boots
items.Description: Legend holds that the mage who created the Gargoyle Boots trapped the spirit of an actual gargoyle within them. Unfortunately, the boots couldn't protect the nameless wizard from the vengeance of the gargoyle's mate. As there are multiple variations on the Gargoyle Boots, it is …

items.Name: Greater Boots of Tumbling
items.Description: Made for members of a militant order of Lliira-worshippers known as the Scarlet Mummers, these boots aid those deadly dancers in their acrobatic assassinations of the agents of the Maiden of Pain.

items.Name: Hellenic Greaves
items.Description: A thoroughly Greek invention, this set of Greaves likely originated in Arborea and somehow found it's way here.  They're tough and strong but obviously built for someone not your size.  Luckily, they have a trick up their metaphorical sleeves...

items.Name: Boots of the Horizon Walker
items.Description: Horizon Walkers are a spedial breed of rangers who specialize in mastery of many types of terrain. They gain almost supernatural speed and navigational skills in these terrain types, and are revered throughout the planes as some of the most knowledgable and competent guides avai…

items.Name: Lizardfolk Boots
items.Description: Designed to fit around a Lizardfolks Clawed feet, other races might find these very uncomfatable.

items.Name: Lesser Boots of Amazing Footwork
items.Description:
This type of footwear was originally owned by a Pirate from the Moonshae Isles named Buck McMasters. Buck enjoyed a famous reign on the high seas with his partner and best friend, a Sembian named Nigel Witherspoon.

These boots were the first magical trinket that Buck ever bough…

items.Name: Lesser Boots of Tumbling
items.Description: Made for members of a militant order of Lliira-worshippers known as the Scarlet Mummers, these boots aid those deadly dancers in their acrobatic assassinations of the agents of the Maiden of Pain.

items.Name: Miner's Boots
items.Description: These boots, while not particularly comfortable will help you keep your balance on the lip of that bottomless chasm, or pit of fire... maybe not such a bad investment.

items.Name: Shadow of the Void Insight AC
items.Description: Should NOT be owned by a PC. If a PC is in possession of this, remove it from their inventory.

items.Name: Boots of the Shifting Sands
items.Description: The most infamous halfling bard in Faerun, Stompin' Con Tommers, claimed that entire tribes of goblins would quiver in fear when they heard he was coming. Strangely enough, the boasts of this halfling might have had some basis in truth, as the magical boots he wore really could …

items.Name: Sunken Greaves
items.Description: This pair of azure boots provide the wearer with an ongoing ability to survive the watery depths with surprising aptitude. One finds that they are able to breathe underwater and even walk on the seabed with relative ease - there is even some limited protection against deep press…

items.Name: Sure Foot Slippers
items.Description:
This unassuming pair of dainty leather boots sets high, above the kneeline, and has been coloured a lovely gold. The enchantment they bare was intended to aid the classier adventurer from soiling their finery by being tossed to the ground in a fight. 

Odds are that the gruff an…

items.Name: Survivalist Boots
items.Description: 'Boots of Reflexes done right', is what the planeswalker Arimathel set out to create, and certainly she did - these pads not only enhance one's natural quickness to react against threats but are intuitive enough to try and guide the wearer out of harm's way in combat.

items.Name: Sneak Shoes of the Dying Light
items.Description: These lightweight boots are very well-balanced and would be perfect for moving around silently, tumbling or maintaining one's footing.  They are made of soft leather and bear the insignia of the assassin's guild, The Dying Light.

items.Name: Boots of Tumbling
items.Description: Made for members of a militant order of Lliira-worshippers known as the Scarlet Mummers, these boots aid those deadly dancers in their acrobatic assassinations of the agents of the Maiden of Pain.

items.Name: Boots of the Winterlands
items.Description: A common magic item among adventurers, travelers and monsters native to areas of cold climate, these thick, furry boots have been enchanted to magically warm the wearer, offering protection against cold similar to that provided by an endure elements spell.

items.Name: Acrobats Aid
items.Description:
These bracers help the wearer in jumping and tumbling.

Originally created by a monastic order, they were scattered to the four winds during a gibberling hordes assault on the ancient gates, very few still exist today.

items.Name: Bracers of Archery
items.Description: These wristbands look like normal protective wear. The bracers grant the wearer increased speed when using bows. They are likely from the armory of some disbanded elven militia.

items.Name: Bracers of Blasting
items.Description: Plain and featureless, these bracers are activated by tapping the wrists together. They are popular with adventurers who prefer a more showy display of power, for the effect is not subtle.
PropertiesDecoded: Balagarn's Iron Horn (7) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Bracers of Armour (Dweomered)
items.Description: These items at first appear to be simple wrist or arm guards, but they surround the wearer with an invisible field of force, and grant protection just like mundane armor. They are likely from the armory of some disbanded militia.

items.Name: Bracers of Agility (Dweomered)
items.Description:
Bracers of this type were first made, believe it or not, in Mechanus. 

The Jade Palace is the source of many such trinkets, which are enchanted to aid the Celestial Emperor Shang-ti's guards. They get a lot of practice, as the Palace's many orchards are known to grow peaches of…

items.Name: Bracers of Epic Health
items.Description:
These platinum armbands both bear the image of a dragon, and are studded with four diamonds each, which are all cut to look like sparkling spikes. 

When worn, the diamond's protrude down through the material of the armbands to touch the flesh of the wearer and take on a dull bl…

items.Name: Bracers of Locking Grip
items.Description: Henisevan le Daliya - a boyish, effeminate noble - had the curious goal of becoming a master swordsman. To counter his limp grip (and avoid "unsightly muscle growth"), he had the court wizards craft several pairs of bracers, each locking hand-to-blade. All was well until a cleve…

items.Name: An Open Hand
items.Description:
These two lengths of red cord mean nothing, unless wrapped around the wrists of the servants of the Crying God, Ilmater.

With their hands bound together by these red cords, the Ilmater faithful can spread healing throughout the land, though at great risk to their own bodies.
PropertiesDecoded: Lawful Good Use Limitation: Specific Alignment
Lawful Neutral Use Limitation: Specific Alignment
Neutral Good Use Limitation: Specific Alignment

items.Name: Ornate Bracers
items.Description:
These bracers seem rather to be decorative than they are of any real protection or use. They are intricate int their gold and emerald motifs and tracery, and must have cost a fortune to make.

They do seem to make wrist- and hand movement somewhat quicker, but that may be imagin…

items.Name: Showman's Bracers
items.Description:
These delightful items aid in performance and in the memory. Arman, a bard once renowned in the Ironridge area, is reputed to have performed for 24 hours non-stop while wearing a pair... 

...and he still had cries for more.

items.Name: Bracers of the Troll
items.Description: A mad archmage looked upon several warriors battling a small tribe of trolls. He took note at the regenerative properties of trolls and decided to have one captured for study, which was not an easy task, but luckily for him, there are many mercenaries for hire in Faerun. Many we…

items.Name: A-6 Commander Cloak
items.Description: After the assassination of the High Selunian Priestess, the church invested some time and money coming up with a way to protect their members against the aggressive followers of Mask. Once the powers of these cloaks became known, however; the clerics wearing such cloaks became t…

items.Name: Cloak of Arachnida
items.Description:
This black garment, embroidered with a web-like pattern in silk, gives the wearer many of the abilities of a spider.  The cloak also grants immunity to entrapment by web spells or webs of any sort.

Cloaks of this type are common with drow, particularly those who worship Lolth.

items.Name: Anglar's Batcloak
items.Description:
Anglar Semberthann was a roguish cat burglar with a flair for the theatrical.

He is known to have operated in Waterdeep, a metropolis on the prime world of Toril, for about thirteen seasons, but there has been no recorded mention of him for at least a decade.

He became known a…

items.Name: Cloak of Blackflame
items.Description: This cloak resembles a tangle of thick, black cobwebs when not worn, but smoothes into a woven black cloak of coarse threads when donned.  It protects its wearer from energy-draining attacks.
PropertiesDecoded: Undead AC Bonus vs. Racial Group +2

items.Name: Bounty Hunter Cloak
items.Description: After the assassination of the High Selunian Priestess, the church invested some time and money coming up with a way to protect their members against the aggressive followers of Mask. Once the powers of these cloaks became known, however; the clerics wearing such cloaks became t…

items.Name: Cheetah Cloak
items.Description: This yellow and black-spotted cheetah hide was enchanted by a shaman from The Vile Hunt, a clan of Malarites operating out of The Beastlands.

items.Name: Cloak of Planes Travel
items.Description: A cloak made of a soft material. runes and symbols are sewn into it.

items.Name: Artemus' Cloak of Displacement
items.Description: Interwoven with strands of sinew from a displacer beast's tentacles, the fabric of a Cloak of Displacement distorts and warps light waves, much like the displacement spell, making it much harder for enemies to score a proper hit on the wearer.

items.Name: Cloak of Displacement
items.Description: Interwoven with strands of sinew from a displacer beast's tentacles, the fabric of a Cloak of Displacement distorts and warps light waves, much like the displacement spell, making it much harder for enemies to score a proper hit on the wearer.

items.Name: Cloak of Fortification (Dweomered)
items.Description: These cloaks were originally made popular by high ranking members of The Fated after an Anarchist cell in Sigil had tremendous success assinating three of their factors in the span of two evenings. Rumour has it that the items did their job flawlessly, and the Cage is since shy …

items.Name: Nymph Cloak (Dweomered)
items.Description:
Named for the creatures most closely associated with beauty, these cloaks origins have been lost to time. 

It -is- known, however,  that they were most recently popularized by bards and skalds performing with the Sensates in the Great Feasthall of Sigil.

items.Name: Cloak of Protection (Dweomered)
items.Description: Cloaks of this sort are infused with protective spells, and are among the most popular and numerous magic items on the market. The original design may have originated in the earliest of arcane guilds, but the current makers of these items are varied and widespread.

items.Name: Cape of Earthmeld
items.Description:
This cloak was inspired by the earth itself. 

Just as the awesome destructive force of a volcano can ultimately assist in healing the land, so does the Cape of Earthmeld heal the one who wears it. The fiery red cloth from which it is woven emits a constant warmth, which soaks i…

items.Description: Elven rangers and scouts are given cloaks like this one to help hide them while patrolling the borders of their lands. These cloaks vary in effectiveness, depending on the status of the original owner.

items.Name: Bearskin
items.Description: These heavy fur cloaks are masterfully weaved by their nomad owners to contain the spirit of the hunted animal.

items.Description: Banded Agate is a smooth, banded stone often used as a "soothing stone" handled to relieve tension, especially by merchants during tough negotiations.

items.Name: Beljuril
items.Description: Beljuril is seawater green, periodically blazing with a sparkling, winking, flashing light, also known as fireflashils.  This gem is very rare, durable and very hard.

items.Name: Black Onyx Gem
items.Description: A small black onyx, suitable for some spells such as creating undead. It is often used in necromantic enchantments, or simply as a decoratoin by those who prize black stones.

items.Name: Black Pearl
items.Description:
A decent sized black pearl, though you are not sure what manner of underwater creature from the dark depths creates these. 

They say they are sought after by drow  ladies, and by magic users who crush them into powder for spell components. It may be useful to spellcasters or al…

items.Name: Bloodstone
items.Description: Prized for their vibrant green color, emeralds are fragile and need to be protected from the impacts and extreme temperature changes common to adventuring life. It is a highly prized gem by the wealthy and royalty alike.

items.Name: Moonsea Blood Ruby
items.Description:
Bright and beautiful, the ruby is famous for its clear and bloody hue. None are bloodier in hue or reputation than the Moonsea Blood Rubies. 

Mined in the Dragonspire mountains, these rubies are deep scarlet, and called Blood Rubies. Their reputation comes more from their origi…

items.Name: Blue Quartz
items.Description: Prized for their vibrant green color, emeralds are fragile and need to be protected from the impacts and extreme temperature changes common to adventuring life. It is a highly prized gem by the wealthy and royalty alike.

items.Name: Chalcedony
items.Description: Chalcedony is used to make magical items that ward against undead.

items.Name: Crown of Silver
items.Description: Silver Chalcedony with brilliant metallic black bands.

items.Name: Diamond
items.Description: This transparent crystal is the second hardest substance found in nature. The most valued color is a clear bluish-white; most lesser stones are clear white or off-white, but other less valued color varieties are known, among them mauve, pink, peach, and chartreuse. Due to its ha…

items.Name: Emerald
items.Description: Prized for their vibrant green color, emeralds are fragile and need to be protected from the impacts and extreme temperature changes common to adventuring life. It is a highly prized gem by the wealthly and royality alike. It is also used in spell ink formulae, as a spell compon…

items.Name: Fire Agate
items.Description: Fire agate forms in thin brown layers that refract the incoming light, giving the gem its "fire." The refraction often forms patterns reminiscent of a dragon's scales, which makes it prized by sorcerers who claim to trace their lineage back to dragonkin. A well-cut stone has its…

items.Name: Fire Opal
items.Description: Unlike their more common cousin, fire opals are full of vibrant hues: hot yellows, oranges, and reds so bright they almost cast their own light. Some believe that these gems derive their glow from a supernatural source, and not a few sages have claimed that each gem is a tiny po…

items.Name: Fluorspar
items.Description: A common but beautiful gem, flourspar comes in many colors - each of them nicely set off by the stones' glassy luster. Best known in its purple hues, which are commonly mistaken for amethyst, flourspar is the much softer of the two and will scratch, chip, and even burn easily.

items.Name: Garnet
items.Description:
Often called the "Poor Man's Ruby," the common garnet is nevertheless a distinct and attractive blood-red gem in its own right. The violet form, also called rhodolite, is the rarest, most prized, and most valuable form of the stone. 

Folktales claim garnets are the hardened blo…

items.Name: Greenstone
items.Description: As its name indicates, this gem is generally green in color. Typical samples, however, have a pattern of overlapping edges that range from yellow-green to almost black. When polished, they have a beautiful play of light within their crystalline structure. Greenstones are extreme…

items.Name: Hematite
items.Description: Prized by fighters, often used in magical peripats.

items.Name: Hyaline
items.Description: Hyaline is a milky quartz flecked with gold.

items.Name: Hydrophane
items.Description: Hydrophane is frosty-white or ivory opal, opaque, and often used in water-oriented items.

items.Name: Iol
items.Description: Iol is a color-changing jewel, straw yellow, blue, and dark blue, sometimes with an internal star effect. It has a strong association with magic in Faerunian legend.

items.Name: Irtios
items.Description: Irtios is colourless or very pale yellow, hard and translucent; often found on sword scabbards and wizard's staves.

items.Name: Ivory
items.Description:
Ivory is a white substance that comprises mammal teeth or tusks, carved and polished.

Unicorn horns are technically not ivory since they are not teeth.  It should also be noted that unicorn horns are not used for ornamental carving and that they command prices of thousands of g…

items.Name: Jacinth
items.Description: A fiery orange jewel also called Hyacinth or flamegem, the true corundum Jacinth is found only in Faerun.

items.Name: Jade
items.Description: Jade is said to enhance musical ability and is worn as a lucky stone by some musicians.

items.Name: Jet
items.Description: Jet is the stone of mourning and sorrow in wealthy cities. It is hightly prized by the Drow as well, who use it in everything from jewellry to decorating armour, weapons and temples.

items.Name: King's Tears
items.Description: King's Tears are clear, teardrop-shaped, smooth-surfaced, and awesomely hard. Sometimes called frozen tears or lich weepings, they are very rare.

items.Name: Laeral's Tears
items.Description: Large, colorless, crystalline, soft, brittle stones named for the famous sorceress Laeral of Waterdeep.

items.Name: Lapis Lazuli
items.Description: Dark to sky-blue with gold flecks, opaque.

items.Name: Malachite
items.Description: Favored by druids for its graceful and natural beauty, malachite is known for its strikingly ornamental bands of light and dark green that alternate throughout the entire stone. Painters have also been known to crush the gem and use it as a pigment. Adventurers have discovered t…

items.Name: Moonstone
items.Description: Used in magic items that control lycanthropy, affect lycantrhopes or protect against lycanthropes, Moonstones are considered sacred to Selune, Eilistraee and Sehenine Moonbow.

items.Name: Moss Agate
items.Description: Moss Agate is said to promote serenity and stability.

items.Name: Obsidian
items.Description: Obsidian can be chipped into arrowheads or weapons. It is used by savage tribes, but also prized by Drow and other underdark races, who gather it from volcanic vents for decorative use.

items.Name: Opal
items.Description: Opal is used in a number of magic items and spells. It is also highly prized for jewellry.

items.Name: Orl
items.Description: Red (most-valued), tawny or orange crystal.

items.Name: Orprase
items.Description: Faintly straw yellow, brittle, medium hardness, popular with followers of Tymora.

items.Name: Peridot
items.Description: Peridot is used in enchantments that protect against spells.

items.Name: Phenalope
items.Description: A singularly beautiful stone, phenalope is dusty pink in color, dramatically marked with black streaks. Even when mounted in jewelry, phenalope maintains a rough texture, pocked with tiny holes that cannot be polished out. For some, this is part of the stone's attraction, and th…

items.Name: Ravenar
items.Description: Glossy black tourmaline, mainly valued in the North and in the Underdark.

items.Name: Red Tears
items.Description: Vivid, cherry-red, blood-crimson, or fiery orange crystals also called Tempus' Weeping, legends say they are the tears of lovers shed for their beloveds who were slain in battle.

items.Name: Rock Crystal
items.Description: Used in optics and prisms.

items.Name: Ruby
items.Description: Bright and beautiful, the ruby is famous for its clear and bloody hue. To some it is the gem of love, to others the gem of revenge. To all it is said to be lucky and is unquestionably precious. The largest, most flawless specimens are more highly prized than diamonds. The goddes…

items.Name: Ruby of Zaltar
items.Description: Bright and beautiful, the ruby is famous for its clear and bloody hue. To some it is the gem of love, to others the gem of revenge. To all it is said to be lucky and is unquestionably precious. The largest, most flawless specimens are more highly prized than diamonds. The goddes…

items.Name: Sun Amber
items.Description: Often used as a good luck charm to ward off disease and plague, amber is the fossilized sap from ancient trees. This particular form of amber is very rare, as it stems from plants in regions that are now, possibly have always been, deserts - and are thus often considered holy ge…

items.Name: Sanidine
items.Description: Pale tan to straw yellow with red flashes, favourite of the Bedine.

items.Name: Sapphire
items.Description: The blue sapphire is twin to the more precious ruby in all respects but color. In most stones, the sparkling blue color must be brought out by exposure to great heat. Once "cooked," the color change is permanent and does not otherwise affect the much-treasured durability of the …

items.Name: Sardonyx
items.Description: Often used in spells that affect wisdom.

items.Name: Smokey Quartz
items.Description: Black variety of quartz, also called morion and used by necromancers.

items.Name: Spodumene
items.Description: Pink-to-purple gem also known as ghost stone because its color fades with time.

items.Name: Star Sapphire
items.Description: A brilliant stone, often used in devices that offer protection against hostile magical energies.

items.Name: Tiger Eye Agate
items.Description: Golden Agate with dark brown stripings, legends state that nonmagical tigereyes are useful in repelling spirits and undead creatures.

items.Name: Tomb Jade
items.Description: Tomb Jade is a rare, highly prized jade that has turned red or brown through being buried for great lengths of time.

items.Name: Topaz
items.Description: Best known in its pale, orange-yellow form, topaz is an attractive gem that appears in well-formed, multifaceted crystals. These crystals can reach an incredible size, and specimens weighing several hundred pounds are not unknown. The largest stones are customarily reserved for …

items.Name: Tourquoise
items.Description: Prized by elves for use in sky-related spells, mages use this gem in the creation of spells related to flight.

items.Name: Violine
items.Description: A purple, volcanic gemstone.

items.Name: Water Opal
items.Description: Translucent variety of opal used as ornaments around mirrors and windows or in the crafting of magical scrying devices such as crystal balls.

items.Name: Waterstar
items.Description: Rare light blue to colourless tourmaline.

items.Name: Zircon
items.Description: Zircon gems are occasionally passed off as more valuable gemstones, and popular amongst forgers due to the ease with with Zircon can be cut or otherwise manipulated.

items.Description:
Hammered from a gorgon's armor plates, this helm mounts two crystal lenses over the wearer's eyes.  These special lenses, made from the calcified corneas of a medusa, allow the wearer to use the medusa's petrification gaze attack.

PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Her Beneficence
items.Description: This tome is thick and still it is light in your hand and bound in leather that seems to shimmer even in the darkest of nights. It is written in elaborate, decorative handwriting of a fairly archaic language, and is of exquisite handiwork - as if the rare content was not enough.…

items.Name: The Dragon Queen
items.Description:
This tome is thick and bound in dark scales, and has a symbol of five dragon heads on it. It is written in elaborate, decorative handwriting of a fairly archaic language, and is of exquisite handiwork - as if the rare content was not enough.

"Tiamat
-------------------
The Chro…

items.Name: Book of Undead Summons
items.Description:
This dusty tome, reeking of decay, weighs heavy in your hands, seemingly pulsing with some inner life and evil of its own.

It notes the sickening details and rituals required for animating the very flesh and bones of the dead; Those who delve deeper into the book may even read …
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Vlaicu Posada Guide to Creatures
items.Description:
A book handwritten by Count Vlaicu describing several creatures.

The Horror - This was an experiment I did under the tutuledge of it. It was pure luck that a girl child wandered into my realm. As instructed, I subjected the child to every horror I could think up. It took only t…

items.Name: Bolts of Spider Silk
items.Description:
Bolts of finely spun spider silk, the softest and smoothest material to be found in the Underdark. It comes in a variety of colours, most commonly black, purples, reds, greens and undyed silvers and greys.

Many tailors use spidersilk and buy it whenever they can acquire some, a…

items.Name: Bolts of Kara-Turan Silk
items.Description:
Bolts of finely spun Kara-Turan silk, the softest and smoothest material to be found. It comes in a riot of rich colours and patterns.

Many tailors would sell their apprentices for the chance to set needle and thread to a bolt of this fine foreign silk.

items.Name: Broken Mirror
items.Description: Bad luck, mate.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Broom
items.Description: This dusty item has apparently never been used in this shop. But for a few coins you may buy it and possibly clean up a little......

items.Name: Doll
items.Description: A doll. Some child must have lost it.

items.Name: Drow Ear
items.Description:
This is a severed elven ear. It has been dried out a bit, but the jet colour of the skin is still telling as to its origin.

This ear used to belong to a dark elf, one of the Drow...
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Pickled Eel Tongue
items.Description: Disgusting as it is, pickled eel tongues are a favourite amongst sailors. Go to any dockside tavern, and it's fairly easy to find a sailor or pirate who is all too happy to show you that they are indeed edible.

items.Name: Vintage Elven Berry Wine
items.Description:
A rare elven wine distilled by the sylvan elves of the Greycloak Hills. This unique recipe uses berries picked on the sun-soaked slopes of the Greycloak Hills and the nearby Lonely Moor, as well as unspecified herbs and flowers from the Forgotten Forest.

The Vinyard operated by…

items.Name: Empty Bottle
items.Description: An empty glass bottle
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Fingerbone
items.Description: A human-like fingerbone, carved slightly and smoothed down, perhaps to make it more presentable. Whether it was meant as jewellry, or as a component for some dastardly ritual, you cannot say.

items.Name: Baboon Flag
items.Description: A flag with a baboon on it.  Monkeys of various sorts are often assosciated with trickery, roguery, and pranks, as well as cunning.  In some cultures they bring about good luck.

items.Name: Flag (Bull)
items.Description: The bull is a symbol of not only brute strength, but also virility, plenty, and harvest bounty.

items.Name: Flag (Dragon)
items.Description: Dragons are symbols of strength, power, and rapine.  Towards the Unapproachable East, though, they are symbols of wisdom, courage, tenacity, and knowledge.

items.Name: Flag (Horse)
items.Description: Horses are symbols of virility, swiftness, loyalty, steadfastness, and duty.

items.Name: Flag (Hound)
items.Description: Hounds are symbols of the hunt, of tenacity, of patience, of strength and endurance.

items.Name: Flag (Rooster)
items.Description: The rooster is a symbol of virility, rule, assertation, and royalty.  No, really.

items.Name: Flag (Serpent)
items.Description: The serpent is a symbol of cunning, treachery, and lies, but it is also a symbol of patience, of vicious retribution, and painful deterrence.

items.Name: Flag (Tiger)
items.Description: Tigers are symbols of strength, power, speed, and pride.

items.Name: Glasses
items.Description:
This pair of spectacles looks well made, of gold and metal, with finely polished glass lenses.

It looks to be dwarven or gnomish work. Very delicate and light, yet stronger than they look.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: A Gnome's Arm
items.Description:
At first glance, this small severed arm might be mistaken for that of a child, but closer inspection reveals the hand to belong to an adult. One of the wee races.

Too stout for a halfling arm, and not thick enough to be a dwarf's. Fresh gnome must be on the menu tonight...
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 40% of Weight

items.Name: The Golden Gith
items.Description: The Golden Gith, so named after the reputable inn in Sigil, is actually not of Gith origin at all.  It rather portrays a stylized metal caricature of one of Zerthimon's offspring, but carries a few magical powers to boot.

items.Name: Grain seeds
items.Description: Dry Grain seeds, perhaps you would prefer a life of a farmer to that of an adventurer?

items.Name: Guitar
items.Description: It's a six-stringed instrument used by bards. Its sound is not as pleasant as the lute, but it has a deeper tone and is simpler to play. Guitars are gaining popularity, but highly skilled bards turn their nose up at them, referring to it as a 'Gypsy's Lute'.

items.Name: Yarting of Pandemonium
items.Description: Like their namesake plane, these instruments produce shifting, disconsolate tones that seem to penetrate the ear and confuse the senses. When strummed by a talent, these random notes coalesce into fields of pure chaos, turning dedicated enemies into dazed idiots.
PropertiesDecoded: Tasha's Hideous Laughter (7) Cast Spell 3 Uses/Day

items.Name: Herald's Trumpet
items.Description: Heralds often use this as prelude to announcements, to indicate the start of festivities, and to start or proclaim the victor in contests.  Tyros can barely make a few decent notes; experts can play a variety of calls and songs.

items.Name: Violin (Female)
items.Description: The violin's origins vary; some say it was developed in Amn, others in the Dales, still others that it is a variant of an instrument that came from Kara-Tur.  Either way, in the hands of a skilled player it produces quite sonorous and soothing music.

items.Name: Violin (Male)
items.Description: The violin's origins vary; some say it was developed in Amn, others in the Dales, still others that it is a variant of an instrument that came from Kara-Tur.  Either way, in the hands of a skilled player it produces quite sonorous and soothing music.

items.Name: Lemon
items.Description:
This yellow rinded fruit is known as a lemon, and it is imported the Moonsea region from lands to the south by way of the Sea of Fallen Stars.

It is very sour, and few people can stand to eat one. They say the Sembian sailors squeeze just the juices over their food or into thei…
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Lime
items.Description: This green rinded fruit is known as a lime, and it is imported to the Moonsea region from lands to the south by way of the Sea of Fallen Stars. It has also recently found increasing popularity on the Sword Coast, imported by a number of merchant costers with shipping interests i…
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Aniseed
items.Description:
Used to erase your scent trail when making an escape.

Aniseed is highly illegal, because it not only throws animals off your scent, it also kills their sense of smell for an extended period of time
PropertiesDecoded: Choking Powder Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Brighteye's Blends Cigar
items.Description: These ordinary looking cigars bear a paper ring, boldly annoucing their brand: Brighteye's Blends of Faunel.

items.Name: Catstink
items.Description:
Used to erase your scent trail when making an escape.

Catstink smells like cats, of course.  Its less powerful than aniseed, but also costs less, and is just as effective normally.
PropertiesDecoded: Stinking Cloud (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Curdled Cows Milk
items.Description: Thick white liquid that upon taste seems it to be cows milk. However in this case the bitter taste and lumpy texture determine it to be curdled.

items.Name: Grimlock War Skull
items.Description: Grimlock Cultist take the heads of their enemies to the Illithids to enchant them to use in battle. Almost every tribe has a favored skull to frighten their foes and victims.

items.Name: Minotaur's Hewn Horn
items.Description: Once you've slain a Faerzess Infused Minotaur and cleaved off his horn for a trohy, theren not much that can scare or intimidate you. Just rub this for good luck, and give 'em hell!

items.Name: Gem of Elemental Summoning
items.Description:
This gem seems to shift it shape, color and texture gradually, though not quickly enough for any change to be noticable from viewing it. 
 When thrown to the ground in combination with the proper command word being shouted, the gem shatters and lets loose a huge elemental of ra…
PropertiesDecoded: Summon Creature VII (13) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Greater Lodestone
items.Description:
What appears to be a simple stone at first glance is soon revealed to be more when you attempt to lift it.  This stone grows heavier or lighter at command, and is always at least as heavy as lead. 

To get it to grow heavier, you scratch along its surface in a clockwise directio…

items.Name: Gnawed off Toe
items.Description:
The severed big toe from a big smelly human.

You sure you want to be touching it with your bare hands?
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Gnomish Mechanical Key
items.Description: A Mechanical Key is an ingenious invention that once inserted into a lock, automatically unlocks it over the course of 30 seconds for a simple lock, to a minute for a good lock.  It is good for only a single use, and is however, quite easy to hear as it hums and clinks within th…

items.Name: Immovable Rod
items.Description:
An immovable rod is a more famous magical item.  Upon pressing the button the rod becomes innert and it cannot be moved.  Crafty adventurers can find many uses for them, such as blocking a door, or forming a ladder.  

A few famous bardic stories place them being used to unhorse…

items.Name: Lodestone
items.Description:
What appears to be a simple stone at first glance is soon revealed to be more when you attempt to lift it.  This stone grows heavier or lighter at command, and is always at least as heavy as lead. 

To get it to grow heavier, you scratch along its surface in a clockwise directio…

items.Name: Lute
items.Description:
This lute is of fine construction, but not notable in its make.

It has a deep, rich tone, and is quite easy to play, if you have the aptitude for music.

items.Name: Forest Troll Totem
items.Description: Totems of forest troll shamen, these crude creations are made of humanoid bodyparts, usually cut off while thie victim is alive and during ritual torture, and then inscribed with magical runes in the victim's own blood. They tend to last until the bodypart rots, upon which a new…
PropertiesDecoded: Inflict Minor Wounds (1) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Jar of Oil
items.Description:
A Jar of oil.  Used in general by rogues to oil rusty door hinges, or to loosen stuck windows.  

It can also be smashed or poured on the ground as a means to slowing down pursuers.  As an added bonus it is also flammable, and may be used to set fires more easily.

items.Name: Orb of Undeath
items.Description: This is a orb that draws directly from the negative plane of energy to summon and create undead companions.
PropertiesDecoded: Create Greater Undead (18) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day
Acolyte of the Skin Use Limitation: Class

items.Name: Rope and Grapple
items.Description: This lengt of rope is secured firmy to a steel grappling hook. It tends to be used by those scaling walls or sheer cliff faces.

items.Name: Smoke Bomb
items.Description:
A set of 3 smoke bombs. Imported from the far east in times past, they have become increasingly popular with many professional thieves and assasins.

These versions do not explode when thrown, but rather vanish, releasing a cloud of magical smoke.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 40% of Weight

items.Name: Smoke Bomb
items.Description: When thrown, this small sphere explodes into a cloud of smoke.  Imported from the far east in times past, they have become increasingly popular with many professional thieves and assasins.

items.Name: Smoke Bomb
items.Description: A set of 6 smoke bombs.  Imported from the far east in times past, they have become increasingly popular with many professional thieves and assasins.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 40% of Weight

items.Name: Keg of Smoke Powder
items.Description: Smoke powder is not used by most rogues.. but it does however, have its uses.  As either that nessacary distraction, that flashy assasination to inspire fear into your rivals, or that 'accident' in your rivals bar.  Its up to you how you use it.

items.Name: Tarpaper
items.Description: Tarpaper is a piece of canvas cloth coated with tar on one side. You press it to a window before breaking it to muffle the sound of the broken glass shattering all over the place

items.Name: Trumpet Archon Trumpet
PropertiesDecoded: War Cry (7) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Wax Bar
items.Description: Wax bars are generally used by rogues to make imprints of keys, or of carved runes and symbols.

items.Name: Windfan
items.Description: This fan, when flapped in conjuction with the utterance of the proper command word, causes a sudden gust of wind to come from nowhere, toppling objects over and blowing bad odors away.
PropertiesDecoded: Gust of Wind (10) Cast Spell 3 Uses/Day

items.Name: White Pawn Chess Piece
items.Description: A White chess piece in the shape of a pawn carved from fine marble. It functions as a symbol of rank for new recruits in The White Pawn.

items.Name: White Queen Chess Piece
items.Description: A White chess piece in the shape of a queen carved from fine marble. It functions as a symbol for persons, homes, or property protected by it's relationship to or ownership by White Pawn members.

items.Name: White Rook Chess Piece
items.Description: A White chess piece in the shape of a rook carved from fine marble. It functions as the symbol of rank for combat oriented White Pawn members such as bodyguards, enforcers, and thugs.

items.Name: Mimir
items.Description: "You've never seen a skull like this one, cutter - it's made of a silvery metal, with rainbow hues cascading over its shiny surface. Local bashers call it a mimir. Toss it into the air, and ask it questions: What is Ecstasy? Do fiends patrol the Outlands? The floating skull slic…
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Miniature: Adversaries I - The Beast
items.Description: This miniature statue looks something like a mix of a minotaur and a horned demon. It has large claws on its hands and long, vicious fangs, large horns, and its muscles are exaggeratedly clear under a finely carved fur. It has miniature gems, probably rather cheap ones, staring …

items.Name: Miniature: Adversaries II - The Knight
items.Description:
Defiant, proud, and handsome, this miniature knight looks defiantly and challenging. With ornate but practical armour carved into the stone with a seeming as that of an armoursmith, this sculpture is quite a treat.

This miniature is a copy of a statue found in the Gallery of Sc…

items.Name: Miniature: Adversaries III - The Princess/The Price
items.Description: Exaggeratedly feminine, and leaning slightly towards the left - seemingly also away from something as she has a careful glance to the other side and seems to attempt to cover herself from it. Many of the features are slightly more pronounced than what is likely real, but not to …

items.Name: Miniature: Betrayal
items.Description: This miniature statue shows a quite beautiful man, if somewhat old. It is a good work, and the detail is fine if a bit off in some places. The fabric of the shirt doesn't fall just quite right, and there is a strange direction to some of the beard. It is still quite a feat to pu…

items.Name: Ancient Miniature
items.Description:
This miniature is from an unknown prime that is rumoured to be reachable from the Slags. Exactly who it depicts or why is hard to say, but the figure looks proud and regal as well as beautiful. Perhaps she was some kind of queen?

At the base is a series of hieroglyphs possibly …

items.Name: Miniature: The Gypsy
items.Description: This miniature statue, made of some dark, greenish and jade-like stone, depicts a young woman with a dress made up of many different pieces all made into an elaborate pattern, with a shawl wrapped over head and shoulders. One hand is in a bag in one of the belts around her waist…

items.Name: Miniature: The Night Hag
items.Description: Beautiful body, hideous face nearly hidden. Desirable yet horrible. This miniature statue captures the two sides of the Nightmare on the spot, all down to the hungry stare of the eyes. The black stone it is made of strengthens the impression, just as the red gems set into the ey…

items.Name: Miniature: The Slave Maiden
items.Description: This miniature, made of a light marble of remarkable quality, depicts a beautiful and curvy young woman. Her dress is torn asunder some and she tries to hold it up to cover herself, failing and showing two bare breasts. Her head is lowered in shame and submission and she seems c…

items.Name: Miniature: Eternal Servitude
items.Description: Hollow, empty eye-sockets, skin stretched across bones and a ghastly expression in a toothless face, together with dislocations of some of the limbs, this miniature statue simply must depict some sort of mummy or zombie. It is well made if exaggerating the pain and agony animate…

items.Name: Miniature: The Valiant Queen
items.Description: This miniature statue depicts an elven knight, clad in intricate plate armour with a large blade beside her. Her face is beautiful and full of conviction and strength. It is quite a nice statue, even if the feminine forms, in the form of minimal waist and emphasised bust, would …

items.Name: Miniature: The Werewolf
items.Description: Although massively distorted in proportion, and with horn-like ears, this miniature werewolf is fearsome to behold. It has tufted fur, a hungry snarl on its face, and large claws on feet and hands ready to hunt its victim. It is hard to imagine it was made without any model, yet…

items.Name: Meenlock Skull
items.Description: This is the skull of a meenlock. It is twisted and deformed, seeming to originally have been more humanoid. It's very odd shape may mean it's worth something. Berks are strange, after all.

items.Name: Mistwood Worg Hide
items.Description: This hide, from the Mistwood Worg, is covered in black, silken fur that shimmers with the faintest of light, while managing to still remain dark somehow. It is soft to the touch, yet still durable and strong. Among furs, it is one of the most valuable and sought after.

items.Name: Mistwood Worg Packmother's Fang
items.Description: This is the fang of one of the packleader's of the Mistwood Worgs. It is impressively large for a canine, and also very sharp.

items.Name: Orc Toe
items.Description:
The severed big toe from a big smelly orc.

You sure you want to be touching it with your bare hands?
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Paint Brushes
items.Description:
A set of fine paint brushes made from the whiskers of a manticore killed on the High Moor. Or so claimed the Drow merchant who imported them from the city of Eryndlyn.

These brushes are of the finest quality and the set includes a number of tiny ones for intricate detailing. A …
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 40% of Weight

items.Name: Paint Brushes and Paint
items.Description:
This is a set of standard paint brushes and nine colours of paint.

The paints include black, blue, gold, green, purple, red, silver, white and yellow.

items.Name: Panpipes
items.Description: It's a flute type instrument used by bards.

items.Name: Parasol
items.Description: A parasol is used by ladies to keep the sun out of their eyes, and provide a bit of shade. It is a common fashion accessory for nobles.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Parasol (Night)
items.Description: The parasol is a common fashion accessory among nobles. This one is decorated with dark patterns, intended for use at night-time parties and balls, more than for providing shade during the day-time. It would certainly work for that, but who in their right mind would go about in …
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Stack of Parchament
items.Description: A stack of many sheets of blank parchement bundled up and ready for use. A must for scribes or writers, but also a requirement in any serious wizard or alchemist labratory or music conservatory.

items.Name: Everfull Flask of Pure Element
items.Description:
Pure Element can be taken from a variety of sources, all found on the various inner planes. It is used by pouring the contents over one's clothing or flesh.

This flask was filled with the remains of a Primal Earth Elemental, and never seems to run out completely.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 20% of Weight

items.Name: Pickled Eel
items.Description:
A favorite of sailors, there are often many barrels of pickled eel hanging around any properly laden ship.

These eels were caught up north and pickled with a special recipe that is apparently a local favorite. Yeah, if you're a hick from Ten Towns or a yokel from Luskan, perhap…

items.Name: Porcelain Jar
items.Description:
This porcelain vase is finely made and masterfully decorated. The finest fired porcelain from the far east, it has been shaped with care and painstakingly painted with intricate detail.

It looks fragile, and expensive, even empty.

items.Name: Rope, 100 ft
items.Description:
It is a one hundred foot length of silk rope. It is supple and stronger than hemp or cord rope.

(If tied up with it, it takes a Strength check against DC 28 to break your bonds)

items.Name: Scabbard
items.Description:
Designed to hold weapons, scabbards are a mainstay of the adventurer's gear.

(Only for weapons, any other items contained within face deletion without warning.)

items.Name: Scrawled Parchament
items.Description:
There is no way out of here, except in death. I know that now. How long have I traversed this hole, only find myself stuck in a labrynth of passages I cannot escape?

This will be my last entry, for I have decided to fight my way out so that death may finally find me...
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Serpentine Necklace
items.Description: This amulet seems non-magical, although it is covered in a mass of runes that look very serpentine in their shape, both like snakes and like eyes and tounges. The way they are carved suggest religious origin, and although the amulet does not seem magical, it may work as some sor…

items.Name: Skull
items.Description: The skull of one of the skeletons that has invaded the Chiselchest's family crypt.

items.Name: Shovel
items.Description: It's a sturdy shovel with a hardwood haft and an iron head, the kind used by farmers and miners and treasure seekers.

items.Name: Ankh
items.Description: The ankh is an ancient Mulhorandi symbol of life, death, and rebirth. It is sometimes found in other faiths but it is most closely assosciated with the deities of Mulan.

items.Name: Ankh (Glowing, Green)
items.Description:
The ankh is an ancient Mulhorandi symbol of life, death, and rebirth. It is sometimes found in other faiths but it is most closely assosciated with the deities of Mulan.

The green light is said to be assosciated with Osiris, one of the leaders of the Mulhorandi pantheon.

items.Name: Ankh (Glowing, Yellow)
items.Description: The ankh is an ancient Mulhorandi symbol of life, death, and rebirth. It is sometimes found in other faiths but it is most closely assosciated with the deities of Mulan.

items.Name: Cross
items.Description: The cross is an ancient symbol which is often subject to misinterpretation and confusion.  Some believe it is related to the Mulhorandi Ankh.  Some feel that the three short arms represent Ilmater, Torm, and Tyr, while the long arm represents Ao.  Like most symbols in Faerun, it…

items.Name: Cross (Glowing, Blue)
items.Description: The cross is an ancient symbol which is often subject to misinterpretation and confusion.  Some believe it is related to the Mulhorandi Ankh.  Some feel that the three short arms represent Ilmater, Torm, and Tyr, while the long arm represents Ao.  Like most symbols in Faerun, it…

items.Name: Cross (Glowing, Yellow)
items.Description: The cross is an ancient symbol which is often subject to misinterpretation and confusion.  Some believe it is related to the Mulhorandi Ankh.  Some feel that the three short arms represent Ilmater, Torm, and Tyr, while the long arm represents Ao.  Like most symbols in Faerun, it…

items.Name: Flashy Mage Staff
items.Description: This is a rather typical mage staff.  It isn't quite intended to be more than an accessory, but some mages do appreciate the imagry despite its lack of overwhelming arcane power. It is especially useful and impressive when one's travelling companions forget to bring torches.

items.Name: Lightning Symbol
items.Description: Sky-fire, or lightning, is often assosciated with Talos, God of Storms, but other faiths will claim the symbol readilly enough.

items.Name: Pentagram
items.Description: The pentagram is an oft-used magical symbol, representative of a great many things.  Asking a loremaster what a pentagram means will get you a day-long lecture.  Its intent depends mostly upon the bearer, and to which god the symbol has been dedicated to, if any.

items.Name: Pointed Stick
items.Description:
It's a pointed stick.  Made of wood. 

It's actually a Deep Gnome torch, with soft glowing phosphors smeared around the pointed hat. It gives off faint like to mine by, without filling the tunnel full of smoke, nor giving off any heat to attract predators who see by infravision …

items.Name: Purple Wand
items.Description: Wands of this sort are often used by mages to mark their status; they also come in useful in the dark.

items.Name: Red Wand
items.Description: Wands of this sort are often used by mages to mark their status; they also come in useful in the dark.

items.Name: Scale-Shaped Symbol
items.Description:
The Scales are a holy symbol of gods of Merchants, Trade and Wealth, such as Waukeen. 

In some regions they are also attributed to being a symbol of law and justice, and are used by followers of gods such as Tyr and Hoar.

items.Name: Skull On A Stick
items.Description: It is extremely unlikely that any good deity has blessed this as their symbol.  It's even more unlikely that it's dedicated to Kelemvor.  Wave this around in public at your peril.

items.Name: Wooden Walking Stick
items.Description: It's a simple wooden stick, trimmed to make it a useable yet humble staff.  Items of this type are often found in use by travellers as a walking stick when a quarterstaff is unnecessary; or by mages who don't wish all the flash and glitz of a full-fleged magic staff.

items.Name: Ingots (Adamantium)
items.Description:
A stack of adamantium trade bars, sized and stamped and ready to be used at the forge or as tradebars.

Adamantium is a rarely seen as currency throughout the surface realms, but is commonly used as a trade commodity and currency in the Underdark. Most surface merchants would ra…
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 80% of Weight

items.Name: Ingots (Electrum)
items.Description:
A stack of electrum trade bars, sized and stamped and ready to be used at the forge or as tradebars.

Electrum is a rare currency not used in many nations throughout the realms. However, no one denies its worth and its rarity increases its desireability - most merchants will hon…

items.Name: Ingots (Gold)
items.Description:
A stack of solid gold trade bars, sized and stamped and ready to be used at the forge or as tradebars.

Gold is a standard currency throughout the realms, and is, well, worth its weight in gold, as the Sembians say.  

This is a ten-pound stack of gold tradebars. It has a standa…

items.Name: Ingots (Mithril)
items.Description:
A stack of mithril ingots, sized and stamped and ready to be used at the forge or as tradebars.

Mithril is a rarely seen throughout the surface realms, but is commonly used as a trade commodity amongst the elven and dwarven nations. Most surface merchants would rarely if ever g…

items.Name: Ingots (Platinum)
items.Description:
A stack of platinum trade bars, sized and stamped and ready to be used at the forge or as tradebars.

Platinum is a standard but rarely seen currency throughout the realms. Most merchants are simply not wealthy enough to afford or need platinum in trading, but the larger merchan…

items.Name: Ingots (Silver)
items.Description:
A stack of fine silver ingots, sized and stamped and ready to be used at the forge or as tradebars.

Silver is a standard currency throughout the realms, and is almost always worth one tenth its weight in gold.  

This is a ten-pound stack of silver tradebars. It has a value of …

items.Name: Ingots (Steel)
items.Description:
